milestone.describes: The menu is drawn and stays up: the FallDown! logo in neon over Play, How to play, Highscores and More, with the advert strip along the bottom. The steps past it start a round, which is further than the rating goes - see the note.

steps.expect: The menu: FallDown! in green neon over Play, How to play, Highscores and More.
Still there. This is the two-star milestone.
A round starts: green platforms scrolling upwards, the ball at the top, the crush bar across the top of the screen.
The ball moves left under the tilt.
The round is over by here and the Highscores screen is up, reading 'Last score: 4'. That is the frontier, not the milestone: see the note.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window. A capture includes the window border and title bar, so a position read off a frame is about (8, 31) out.

Tilting works and can be seen working: held at the left edge the ball travels to the left wall and stays against it. It is not enough to keep a round going - see the note for why that is a finding rather than a limitation of the route.
**Every round ends at score 4**, after about three seconds, with no steering, with hard steering, and with gentle steering. A score that does not vary with the input is the thing to explain here.
